questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Everything is oldschool

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer:
So, it's old school which means that you have to give in your chosen courses by hand and then they tell you if the class is full or not, and then you might have to change everything, luckily I only had to move one class.

NB. prepare the courses your want to choose before the registration and make extra oppotunities

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: They could help you at the registration or you could send a mail (and hope that they answer)

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: 9/10. Got my courses, but just had to pick another group

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: have multiple options for classes/schedule

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Histoire du cinéma and Histoire littéraires.
Histoire du cinéma is a fun course that isn’t the hardest and your homework is to study movies.
In Histoire littéraires we read 3 theater pieces and did small test. The teacher was the best! (Anne Ducrey)
